supported_scope: The App natively reviews branch changes and supports local commits and remote pushes. This is partial repository integration; a full CI/CD workflow is not established.
unestablished_scope: Native pull-request creation and status-check orchestration
Unattended CI execution and deployment workflow
required_setup: Use a Git-backed project and separately configured remote authentication for pushes.
constraints: CLI headless CI instructions do not establish the same capability for the interactive App; no added service is included.
